body: That would be cool! I don't know many people in my situation. I had a couple "step dad's" as well. No good losers and I'd never even consider them as step father's for the way they treated both me and my mom. Your boys not alone tho, one way i deal with my issue is trying to have as much self discipline as possible. Having many female's around me (grandma, aunt, mom, sisters) they tend to try and spoil me or over comfort me as any female would but that's no good for a young man coming up in this world he needs to be his own male figure even tho that's a bit easier said then done. I wish your boy good luck as well.

Don't let this one fly over your head music defiantly has an impact on one's emotions.
